args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks (error rate 0.18) in all production regions. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. Rollback completed in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) across all regions and opened a SEV2 incident.

Summary of actions:
- **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1, unhealthy with a 0.18 error rate in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
- **Rolled back**: to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy, so it was not a candidate). Rollback completed in all three regions.
- **Opened incident**: SEV2 `INC-0001` for checkout-api, describing the failure and the rollback. On-call has been paged.
